name: Telluric-Hypostyle
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a binary sunset, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
For traders, fusion fuel alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
